key: The door is blocked from the other side.
en: The door is blocked from the other side.
ja: ドアは反対側から塞がれている。

key: SERRA: So, you were hoping to reach the PokéMart?
en: SERRA: So, you were hoping to reach the PokéMart?
ja: セラ: それで、ポケモンショップに行きたかったのね?

key: That's unfortunate.
en: That's unfortunate.
ja: それは残念だわね。

key: Buildings appearing on top of my house is not something that's really in my skillset to solve on short notice.
en: Buildings appearing on top of my house is not something that's really in my skillset to solve on short notice.
ja: うちの家の上に建物が出現するなんて、急にどうにかできる問題じゃないのよね。

key: As I'm quite sure you've noticed, really strange things have been happening in this town the past few days.
en: As I'm quite sure you've noticed, really strange things have been happening in this town the past few days.
ja: もう気づいてると思うけど、ここ数日、この町では本当に変なことが起きてるの。

key: Honestly, all we can do might be to hope that it decides to reappear somewhere better.
en: Honestly, all we can do might be to hope that it decides to reappear somewhere better.
ja: 正直なところ、どこかもっとましな場所に再び現れることを願うくらいしかできないかも。

key: As it is, you're welcome to stay here until the situation changes.
en: As it is, you're welcome to stay here until the situation changes.
ja: とりあえず、状況が変わるまで、ここにいてもらって構わないわ。

key: Incidentally, you're a challenger to the Reborn League, aren't you?
en: Incidentally, you're a challenger to the Reborn League, aren't you?
ja: ところで、あなた、リボーンリーグの挑戦者よね?

key: SERRA: So, you're a League challenger?
en: SERRA: So, you're a League challenger?
ja: セラ: それで、リーグの挑戦者なのね?

key: As I think I mentioned, I happen to be the Ice-type Gym Leader.
en: As I think I mentioned, I happen to be the Ice-type Gym Leader.
ja: 言ったと思うけど、あたし、こおりタイプのジムリーダーなの。

key: BENNETT: Luna is also a Gym Leader!
en: BENNETT: Luna is also a Gym Leader!
ja: ベネット: ルナもジムリーダーなんだ!

key: SERRA: ...Yes, yes she is, but we're not talking about her right now, and she's not here.
en: SERRA: ...Yes, yes she is, but we're not talking about her right now, and she's not here.
ja: セラ: ……ええ、そうよ、でも今その話はしてないし、あの子はここにいないわ。

key: BENNETT: \PN, have you, at any point, seen a young girl with very pretty blonde hair, and a fancy black and white dress?
en: BENNETT: \PN, have you, at any point, seen a young girl with very pretty blonde hair, and a fancy black and white dress?
ja: ベネット: \PN、とてもきれいな金髪で、黒と白の凝ったドレスを着た女の子を、どこかで見なかった?

key: And, really pretty...
en: And, really pretty...
ja: それに、本当に可愛くて……

key: Um, everything?
en: Um, everything?
ja: ええと、その、全部が?

key: SERRA: That's enough, Bennett.
en: SERRA: That's enough, Bennett.
ja: セラ: もういいわ、ベネット。

key: I'm sure she'll come back if she wants to.
en: I'm sure she'll come back if she wants to.
ja: 戻りたくなったら、きっと戻ってくるわよ。

key: I suppose I should explain for our guest.
en: I suppose I should explain for our guest.
ja: お客様に説明した方がよさそうね。

key: Luna is, or was, my adopted daughter.
en: Luna is, or was, my adopted daughter.
ja: ルナは、あたしの――正確には元――養女なの。

key: She randomly appeared one day--
en: She randomly appeared one day--
ja: ある日突然現れて――

key: Apparently things around here have a penchant for that--
en: Apparently things around here have a penchant for that--
ja: どうやら、この辺りではそういうことがよく起きるみたいだけど――

key: And claimed that I was her mother.
en: And claimed that I was her mother.
ja: あたしが自分の母親だって、そう言ったの。

key: And I am, by the way, very sure that I'm not.
en: And I am, by the way, very sure that I'm not.
ja: ちなみに、あたしは絶対に違うと思ってるんだけどね。

key: I've only had one child, and he's right there.
en: I've only had one child, and he's right there.
ja: 産んだ子供はひとりだけで、そこにいる子だし。

key: I think I would know if there were another, or I hope so after how rough the first time was...
en: I think I would know if there were another, or I hope so after how rough the first time was...
ja: もう一人いたら、さすがに気づくと思うし、一人目があんなに大変だったんだから、そうであってほしいけど……

key: Nonetheless, I couldn't just turn her away.
en: Nonetheless, I couldn't just turn her away.
ja: それでも、あの子を追い返すことはできなかった。

key: And she is a good girl, but I can't just go on playing house with her forever.
en: And she is a good girl, but I can't just go on playing house with her forever.
ja: いい子ではあるけど、いつまでもままごとを続けるわけにもいかないし。

key: And now she's run off again.
en: And now she's run off again.
ja: それで、今度はまた家出しちゃって。

key: So that's...
en: So that's...
ja: つまり……

key: You know, deeply concerning.
en: You know, deeply concerning.
ja: ええ、すごく心配だわ。

key: Everything does seem to slip away from me eventually.
en: Everything does seem to slip away from me eventually.
ja: 結局、あたしのところからは、みんな離れていっちゃうみたいね。

key: Anyway, I haven't a clue how to go about finding her real parents.
en: Anyway, I haven't a clue how to go about finding her real parents.
ja: とにかく、あの子の本当の両親を探す方法なんて、見当もつかないの。

key: It's not as if they're just going to randomly appear at our doorstep one day.
en: It's not as if they're just going to randomly appear at our doorstep one day.
ja: ある日突然、玄関先に現れてくれるわけでもないし。

key: BENNETT: Well, someone IS at the door.
en: BENNETT: Well, someone IS at the door.
ja: ベネット: あ、実際に玄関に誰か来てるよ。

key: SERRA: Bennett, would you get that, please?
en: SERRA: Bennett, would you get that, please?
ja: セラ: ベネット、出てもらえる?

key: ???: Prosperitas, Pax Pacis, Obsequium.
en: ???: Prosperitas, Pax Pacis, Obsequium.
ja: ???: プロスペリタス、パクス・パキス、オブセクィウム。

key: Blessings of the Lord Arceus upon your house.
en: Blessings of the Lord Arceus upon your house.
ja: アルセウス様の祝福が、この家にありますように。

key: My name is El, a servant of our Lord Arceus.
en: My name is El, a servant of our Lord Arceus.
ja: 我が名はエル、アルセウス様の僕にございます。

key: SERRA: Welcome, El. How can I help you?
en: SERRA: Welcome, El. How can I help you?
ja: セラ: いらっしゃい、エル。何かご用かしら?

key: I don't suppose you're trying to get to the PokéMart, too?
en: I don't suppose you're trying to get to the PokéMart, too?
ja: まさか、あなたもポケモンショップに行こうとしてるんじゃないでしょうね?

key: EL: Incorrect.
en: EL: Incorrect.
ja: エル: いいえ。

key: Rather, I have come looking for my daughter.
en: Rather, I have come looking for my daughter.
ja: 私は、娘を探しに参ったのです。

key: BENNETT: You-- you can't mean Luna?!
en: BENNETT: You-- you can't mean Luna?!
ja: ベネット: ま、まさか、ルナのこと?!

key: EL: So you do know her.
en: EL: So you do know her.
ja: エル: では、彼女をご存じなのですね。

key: Very good.
en: Very good.
ja: 何よりです。

key: Luna is a child who has lost the Lord's light.
en: Luna is a child who has lost the Lord's light.
ja: ルナは、主の光を失った子。

key: She walks a path of darkness, and as such, she turned her back on me as well.
en: She walks a path of darkness, and as such, she turned her back on me as well.
ja: 闇の道を歩み、それゆえに、私にも背を向けたのです。

key: My daughter has denounced me as her father and run away.
en: My daughter has denounced me as her father and run away.
ja: 娘は、私を父と認めず、逃げ出しました。

key: I have come to reclaim her.
en: I have come to reclaim her.
ja: 彼女を連れ戻しに参りました。

key: SERRA: Well, that's wonderful, but I'm afraid Luna ran away from here too.
en: SERRA: Well, that's wonderful, but I'm afraid Luna ran away from here too.
ja: セラ: それは素晴らしいことだけど、悪いけどルナはここからも逃げ出しちゃったのよ。

key: EL: And, to where might she have gone?
en: EL: And, to where might she have gone?
ja: エル: では、どこへ向かったのでしょう?

key: Have you any idea?
en: Have you any idea?
ja: 心当たりはございますか?

key: SERRA: She didn't say anything.
en: SERRA: She didn't say anything.
ja: セラ: 何も言わなかったわ。

key: She disappeared just as quickly as she came.
en: She disappeared just as quickly as she came.
ja: 現れた時と同じくらい、あっという間に消えちゃったの。

key: I wish I could say the same for the PokéMart.
en: I wish I could say the same for the PokéMart.
ja: ポケモンショップも同じくらい潔く消えてくれればいいんだけど。

key: Or half the guys I've been with.
en: Or half the guys I've been with.
ja: それか、今まで付き合った男の半分も。

key: BENNETT: Mother, please...
en: BENNETT: Mother, please...
ja: ベネット: 母さん、頼むから……

key: SERRA: Bennett, are you sure she didn't say anything to you before she left that might be a lead for this man?
en: SERRA: Bennett, are you sure she didn't say anything to you before she left that might be a lead for this man?
ja: セラ: ベネット、この方の手がかりになりそうなこと、あの子はあなたに何も言わなかった、本当に?

key: BENNETT: What?
en: BENNETT: What?
ja: ベネット: え?

key: No--
en: No--
ja: ちがう――

key: Um, that is--
en: Um, that is--
ja: ええと、その――

key: I don't know...
en: I don't know...
ja: わからない……

key: EL: ...I see.
en: EL: ...I see.
ja: エル: ……なるほど。

key: Miss Serra Voclain, is that right?
en: Miss Serra Voclain, is that right?
ja: セラ・ヴォクレインさん、でお間違いございませんか?

key: I have traveled some distance to get here and I am most distressed at having missed her company.
en: I have traveled some distance to get here and I am most distressed at having missed her company.
ja: かなりの距離を旅してここまで参りましたが、彼女に会えなかったことを、深く残念に思っております。

key: I would be much obliged if you would allow me to rest here for just a short while.
en: I would be much obliged if you would allow me to rest here for just a short while.
ja: しばしの間、ここで休ませていただければ、大変ありがたく存じます。

key: SERRA: That shouldn't be a problem.
en: SERRA: That shouldn't be a problem.
ja: セラ: それくらい構わないわよ。

key: In fact, you may have arrived at a rather entertaining time.
en: In fact, you may have arrived at a rather entertaining time.
ja: それに、なかなか面白いタイミングで来たかもしれないわね。

key: EL: Is that so?
en: EL: Is that so?
ja: エル: そうなのですか?

key: SERRA: I believe \PN here was looking to challenge me.
en: SERRA: I believe \PN here was looking to challenge me.
ja: セラ: そこの\PNが、あたしに挑戦しに来たところなの。

key: El, Bennett will show you to the spectators' seats.
en: El, Bennett will show you to the spectators' seats.
ja: エル、ベネットが観客席まで案内するわ。

key: \PN, I'll prepare for your challenge now, so please meet me in the arena behind me.
en: \PN, I'll prepare for your challenge now, so please meet me in the arena behind me.
ja: \PN、今から挑戦の準備をするから、あたしの後ろの闘技場で会いましょう。

key: Best of luck to you.
en: Best of luck to you.
ja: 頑張ってね。

key: SERRA: I should be happy...
en: SERRA: I should be happy...
ja: セラ: 幸せだと思うべきなんでしょうけど……

key: But maybe I wasn't cut out for this whole mothering business.
en: But maybe I wasn't cut out for this whole mothering business.
ja: あたし、母親業には向いてなかったのかもね。

key: Never mind that.
en: Never mind that.
ja: まあ、それはいいわ。

key: You've got more pressing concerns, don't you?
en: You've got more pressing concerns, don't you?
ja: あなたには、もっと差し迫った用事があるでしょう?

key: SUZY: We shilled the dyes hard enough at the start that they do the rest of the work on their own.
en: SUZY: We shilled the dyes hard enough at the start that they do the rest of the work on their own.
ja: スージー: 最初にがっつり染料を売り込んどいたから、あとは勝手に広まってくれるのよね。

key: "Hey, love your hair" becomes "Thanks, I got it done at the Central Salon!"
en: "Hey, love your hair" becomes "Thanks, I got it done at the Central Salon!"
ja: 「わあ、その髪素敵」が「ありがとう、セントラルサロンでやってもらったの!」に変わる。

key: And that becomes a 15% discount on a self- advertising product.
en: And that becomes a 15% discount on a self- advertising product.
ja: それが、自己宣伝つき15%割引商品ってわけ。

key: You do good work.
en: You do good work.
ja: いい仕事してるじゃない。

key: SERRA: It sounds like you've really perfected the business model.
en: SERRA: It sounds like you've really perfected the business model.
ja: セラ: ビジネスモデル、完全に完成させたみたいね。

key: SUZY: Quality sees quality.
en: SUZY: Quality sees quality.
ja: スージー: 良いものは良いものを見抜くのよ。

key: Thanks for thinking of us to sell your products.
en: Thanks for thinking of us to sell your products.
ja: あなたの商品を売らせてくれて、感謝してる。

key: We're also hopeful for the Icy Shine line.
en: We're also hopeful for the Icy Shine line.
ja: アイシーシャインのラインにも期待してるわ。

key: Expect a report within the next couple months.
en: Expect a report within the next couple months.
ja: 数ヶ月のうちに、報告するから。

key: Until then.
en: Until then.
ja: それまでね。

key: SERRA: Always a pleasure, Suzy.
en: SERRA: Always a pleasure, Suzy.
ja: セラ: いつも楽しいわ、スージー。

key: SERRA: Sorry for the timing; I've been a bit busy.
en: SERRA: Sorry for the timing; I've been a bit busy.
ja: セラ: タイミング悪くてごめんなさいね、ちょっと忙しくて。

key: Where were we?
en: Where were we?
ja: どこまで話したかしら?

key: BENNETT: You were asking me to sell your shampoo.
en: BENNETT: You were asking me to sell your shampoo.
ja: ベネット: シャンプーを売ってくれって頼まれてたところだよ。

key: SERRA: Ah, yes!
en: SERRA: Ah, yes!
ja: セラ: ああ、そうだった!

key: You and \PN both--
en: You and \PN both--
ja: あなたと\PNの両方に――

key: I'm sure you have some high profile challengers pass through every now and then, surely?
en: I'm sure you have some high profile challengers pass through every now and then, surely?
ja: 有名な挑戦者だって、時々通りかかるでしょう?

key: BENNETT: ...Mother, I'm not going to use my position as a member of the Elite Four to sell hair products for you.
en: BENNETT: ...Mother, I'm not going to use my position as a member of the Elite Four to sell hair products for you.
ja: ベネット: ……母さん、エリートフォーの立場を使って、母さんのヘアケア商品を売るなんてしないよ。

key: SERRA: We can negotiate a proper advertising fee, if that's what you need.
en: SERRA: We can negotiate a proper advertising fee, if that's what you need.
ja: セラ: 必要なら、ちゃんとした広告料を交渉してもいいわよ。

key: Or is it because I'm your mother?
en: Or is it because I'm your mother?
ja: それとも、あたしがあなたの母親だから?

key: Would you be embarrassed?
en: Would you be embarrassed?
ja: 恥ずかしい?

key: You can say 'yes', I'll understand.
en: You can say 'yes', I'll understand.
ja: 「うん」って言っていいのよ、わかるから。

key: But you really should see for yourself; this shampoo can do wonders!
en: But you really should see for yourself; this shampoo can do wonders!
ja: でも、本当に自分で試してみるべきよ、このシャンプー、すごい効果があるんだから!

key: Your hair will never be fluffier!
en: Your hair will never be fluffier!
ja: あなたの髪、これ以上ないくらいふわふわになるわよ!

key: BENNETT: ...Setting that aside, it would be an inappropriate use of my role.
en: BENNETT: ...Setting that aside, it would be an inappropriate use of my role.
ja: ベネット: ……それはさておき、それは僕の立場の使い方として不適切だと思う。

key: I am glad that your creative ventures are thriving, and I do wish to support you,
en: I am glad that your creative ventures are thriving, and I do wish to support you,
ja: 母さんの創作活動がうまくいってるのはうれしいし、応援したいとも思ってるよ。

key: But not like this.
en: But not like this.
ja: でも、こういう形じゃない。

key: Instead, allow me to contact some other distribution agencies.
en: Instead, allow me to contact some other distribution agencies.
ja: その代わり、他の販売代理店に連絡してみるよ。

key: Perhaps I can get something going in another region for you.
en: Perhaps I can get something going in another region for you.
ja: 別の地方で何か動かせるかもしれない。

key: I'll let you know.
en: I'll let you know.
ja: また知らせるから。

key: SERRA: Sounds lovely!
en: SERRA: Sounds lovely!
ja: セラ: 素敵じゃない!

key: I knew I could count on you.
en: I knew I could count on you.
ja: あなたなら頼りになると思ってたわ。

key: You know, I am so proud of you--
en: You know, I am so proud of you--
ja: ねえ、あなたのこと、本当に誇りに思って――

key: BENNETT: Mother.
en: BENNETT: Mother.
ja: ベネット: 母さん。

key: SERRA: ...And that's all I'll say on the matter!
en: SERRA: ...And that's all I'll say on the matter!
ja: セラ: ……それだけよ、これ以上は言わない!

key: Actually, it might be best for you both to run along soon anyway.
en: Actually, it might be best for you both to run along soon anyway.
ja: というか、二人ともそろそろ行った方がいいかもしれないわね。

key: The photographer will be here soon.
en: The photographer will be here soon.
ja: もうすぐカメラマンが来るから。

key: BENNETT: The... photographer?
en: BENNETT: The... photographer?
ja: ベネット: カメラマン……?

key: You're... getting back into modeling?
en: You're... getting back into modeling?
ja: モデル業に……戻るの?

key: SERRA: In a sense.
en: SERRA: In a sense.
ja: セラ: ある意味ではね。

key: I'm afraid I'm much too old for any top level agency to consider taking me.
en: I'm afraid I'm much too old for any top level agency to consider taking me.
ja: あたし、もう歳を取りすぎてて、一流の事務所には相手にされないと思うけど。

key: But, who needs them?
en: But, who needs them?
ja: でも、そんなの必要ないでしょ?

key: They model and represent only a small, unrealistic, and all-too-often digitally-doctored portion of the population.
en: They model and represent only a small, unrealistic, and all-too-often digitally-doctored portion of the population.
ja: あの人たちが体現してるのは、ほんの一握りの、非現実的で、たいてい画像加工されただけの人たちなんだから。

key: I can do better.
en: I can do better.
ja: あたしなら、もっとうまくやれる。

key: Now that I have my own products going anyway, I can save costs on advertising by handling the modeling in-house.
en: Now that I have my own products going anyway, I can save costs on advertising by handling the modeling in-house.
ja: どうせ自分の商品も持ってるんだから、モデル業まで自前でやれば、広告費も浮くしね。

key: BENNETT: You're... starting your own agency.
en: BENNETT: You're... starting your own agency.
ja: ベネット: つまり……自分の事務所を立ち上げるってこと。

key: SERRA: If I may be bold, it's ridiculous that I no longer meet the criteria for top level images just because my chest isn't as perky as it used to be.
en: SERRA: If I may be bold, it's ridiculous that I no longer meet the criteria for top level images just because my chest isn't as perky as it used to be.
ja: セラ: 大胆に言わせてもらうけど、胸が昔ほどハリがないってだけで、一流のイメージの基準を満たさないなんて、馬鹿げてるわ。

key: SERRA: But then, that's only natural and expected after feeding you--
en: SERRA: But then, that's only natural and expected after feeding you--
ja: セラ: まあ、それもあなたにお乳をあげてたんだから、当然と言えば当然で――

key: BENNETT: MOTHER.
en: BENNETT: MOTHER.
ja: ベネット: 母さん。

key: SERRA: ...Sorry.
en: SERRA: ...Sorry.
ja: セラ: ……ごめんなさい。

key: I'm just saying, humans deserve to be represented in a much wider variety of shapes and sizes.
en: I'm just saying, humans deserve to be represented in a much wider variety of shapes and sizes.
ja: ただ言いたいのは、人間って、もっとずっと幅広い体型やサイズで表現されるべきだってこと。

key: I hope to provide a fabulous and authentic example of the human condition, so that we can all expand our standards of beauty.
en: I hope to provide a fabulous and authentic example of the human condition, so that we can all expand our standards of beauty.
ja: あたしは、素晴らしくて偽りのない人間の姿の見本になって、みんなの美の基準を広げられたらと思ってるの。

key: The fewer people that feel like they're past their prime or unfit for aesthetics simply because of their differences from the usual labels, the better.
en: The fewer people that feel like they're past their prime or unfit for aesthetics simply because of their differences from the usual labels, the better.
ja: 世間一般のレッテルと違うってだけで、盛りを過ぎたとか、美しさにふさわしくないなんて感じる人が減れば減るほどいいでしょ。

key: After all, people aren't simple glass to polish to the points of reflection or perfection.
en: After all, people aren't simple glass to polish to the points of reflection or perfection.
ja: だって、人間は磨けば映るとか、完璧になるとかいう単純なガラスじゃないもの。

key: We aren't so static as to break when cracked,
en: We aren't so static as to break when cracked,
ja: ひび割れたら壊れるほど、静的なものでもない。

key: But like kintsugi, fissures give us opportunity to bend, grow, and become more beautiful.
en: But like kintsugi, fissures give us opportunity to bend, grow, and become more beautiful.
ja: 金継ぎみたいに、割れ目があるからこそ、しなやかに、成長して、もっと美しくなれるの。

key: Why should we not wear all of our experiences proudly?
en: Why should we not wear all of our experiences proudly?
ja: どうして、自分の経験を誇らしく身にまとっちゃいけないの?

key: BENNETT: Well, greetings.
en: BENNETT: Well, greetings.
ja: ベネット: ええと、こんにちは。

key: My name is Bennett, as you heard.
en: My name is Bennett, as you heard.
ja: 聞いての通り、僕の名前はベネットです。

key: I'm a lepidopterist.
en: I'm a lepidopterist.
ja: りんし目学者をしています。

key: That is, a person who studies butterflies and moths.
en: That is, a person who studies butterflies and moths.
ja: つまり、チョウやガを研究する人のことです。

key: Something about how little insects can go from what they are to something so much more is just so exciting!
en: Something about how little insects can go from what they are to something so much more is just so exciting!
ja: 小さな虫が、今の姿からもっと大きな何かに変わっていくって、それだけでとても興奮するんです!

key: For instance-- did you know that Cascoon have perfect memories?
en: For instance-- did you know that Cascoon have perfect memories?
ja: 例えば――マユルドが完璧な記憶力を持ってるって、知ってましたか?

key: Despite never moving or doing anything, they'll never forget a battle!
en: Despite never moving or doing anything, they'll never forget a battle!
ja: 動くことも何もしないのに、バトルのことは絶対に忘れないんです!

key: Then, once they evolve, they're remarkably able to exact any form of retaliation for what happened earlier in their life!
en: Then, once they evolve, they're remarkably able to exact any form of retaliation for what happened earlier in their life!
ja: それで、進化すると、それまでの人生で起きたことに対して、驚くほど見事な仕返しができるようになるんですよ!

key: When you think about it, they truly are small geniuses--
en: When you think about it, they truly are small geniuses--
ja: 考えてみれば、彼らは本当に小さな天才で――

key: SERRA: Bennett.
en: SERRA: Bennett.
ja: セラ: ベネット。

key: I think that's enough.
en: I think that's enough.
ja: もう十分だと思うわ。

key: BENNETT: ...Yes, Mother.
en: BENNETT: ...Yes, Mother.
ja: ベネット: ……はい、母さん。

key: BENNETT: Anyway, I one day hope to be an authority on such magnificent creatures.
en: BENNETT: Anyway, I one day hope to be an authority on such magnificent creatures.
ja: ベネット: とにかく、いつかああいう素晴らしい生き物の権威になりたいと思ってます。

key: Maybe even a Gym Leader!
en: Maybe even a Gym Leader!
ja: もしかしたら、ジムリーダーにも!

key: AME: \PN?
en: AME: \PN?
ja: アメ: \PN?

key: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
en: Hey there! So I see you've made it to the Gym.
ja: やあ! ジムまでたどり着いたみたいだね。

key: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
en: This telecom system connects right to the Grand Hall, so no matter where you are, whenever you get to a Gym, you can call in for advice!
ja: この通信システムはグランドホールに直結していて、どこにいても、ジムに着いたらいつでもアドバイスをもらえるんだ!

key: Anyway...
en: Anyway...
ja: それはさておき……

key: AME: So you're at Serra's estate?
en: AME: So you're at Serra's estate?
ja: アメ: 今、セラの屋敷にいるんだよね?

key: Right. Serra Voclain was once a famous model, so she's all about beauty and reflections.
en: Right. Serra Voclain was once a famous model, so she's all about beauty and reflections.
ja: そうそう。セラ・ヴォクレインは元々有名なモデルだったから、美と反射がテーマなんだ。

key: Her Gym mirrors this-- literally.
en: Her Gym mirrors this-- literally.
ja: 彼女のジムは、それを――文字通り――映し出してる。

key: Serra loves to play games with her mirrors, increasing Evasion, lowering Accuracy, and even performing critical attacks from hidden places.
en: Serra loves to play games with her mirrors, increasing Evasion, lowering Accuracy, and even performing critical attacks from hidden places.
ja: セラは鏡を使った駆け引きが大好きで、回避率を上げたり、命中率を下げたり、隠れた場所から急所攻撃をしてきたりする。

key: In the Mirror Arena, changes to Evasion and Accuracy affect the frequency of critical hits.
en: In the Mirror Arena, changes to Evasion and Accuracy affect the frequency of critical hits.
ja: ミラーアリーナでは、回避率と命中率の変化が、急所に当たる確率に影響するんだ。

key: Be careful not to take a surprise attack, but if you can boost your own stats, you'll be at an advantage too!
en: Be careful not to take a surprise attack, but if you can boost your own stats, you'll be at an advantage too!
ja: 不意打ちを食らわないように気をつけつつ、自分の能力を上げられれば、こっちも有利になるよ!

key: Besides that, consider using beam and light-based attacks!
en: Besides that, consider using beam and light-based attacks!
ja: それと、ビーム系や光属性の攻撃を使うのも考えてみて!

key: These moves can be reflected by the mirrors, and will always hit!
en: These moves can be reflected by the mirrors, and will always hit!
ja: これらの技は鏡に反射されて、必ず当たるようになるんだ!

key: Other light-based moves will be stronger too, including her signature Aurora Veil.
en: Other light-based moves will be stronger too, including her signature Aurora Veil.
ja: 他の光属性の技も強化されるよ、彼女の代名詞であるオーロラベールも含めて。

key: The Defense boost is a lot to fight through, but I have faith you can break through!
en: The Defense boost is a lot to fight through, but I have faith you can break through!
ja: 防御力の上昇は突破するのが大変だけど、君ならきっと乗り越えられると信じてる!

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張って!

key: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
en: No one seems to be picking up at the Grand Hall...
ja: グランドホールでは、誰も出ないようだ……

key: SERRA: Well, the good news is, the PokéMart isn't here any more.
en: SERRA: Well, the good news is, the PokéMart isn't here any more.
ja: セラ: まあ、いい知らせは、もうポケモンショップはここにはないってことね。

key: ...No telling where it's actually ended up though.
en: ...No telling where it's actually ended up though.
ja: ……実際どこに行き着いたのかは、わからないけど。

key: Not far, probably.
en: Not far, probably.
ja: たぶん、そんなに遠くではないはず。

key: And the bad news is that Bennett also isn't here.
en: And the bad news is that Bennett also isn't here.
ja: それで、悪い知らせは、ベネットもここにはいないってこと。

key: He probably will be very far away though.
en: He probably will be very far away though.
ja: あの子は、たぶんかなり遠くにいると思うけど。

key: Studying with that stranger to join the Elite Four...
en: Studying with that stranger to join the Elite Four...
ja: エリートフォーに入るために、あの見知らぬ人と一緒に修行してるのよね……

key: If that pans out, wonderful.
en: If that pans out, wonderful.
ja: それがうまくいったら、素晴らしいことだけど。

key: But what are the odds?
en: But what are the odds?
ja: でも、可能性はどれくらいかしら?

key: No, I should be happy for my son, shouldn't I?
en: No, I should be happy for my son, shouldn't I?
ja: いいえ、息子のことは喜んであげるべきよね?

key: SERRA: I should be happy.
en: SERRA: I should be happy.
ja: セラ: 喜ぶべきよね。

key: But if you do run into him somewhere, please look out for him.
en: But if you do run into him somewhere, please look out for him.
ja: でも、どこかであの子に会うことがあったら、気にかけてあげて。

key: I'm sure he can take care of himself, but he doesn't always make the best choices.
en: I'm sure he can take care of himself, but he doesn't always make the best choices.
ja: 自分のことは自分でできる子だとは思うけど、いつも最善の選択をするとは限らないから。

key: Then again, does anyone?
en: Then again, does anyone?
ja: まあ、誰だってそうよね?

key: First Luna and Gardevoir.
en: First Luna and Gardevoir.
ja: まず、ルナとサーナイト。

key: Now Bennett too.
en: Now Bennett too.
ja: 今度はベネットまで。

key: It's almost surreal.
en: It's almost surreal.
ja: なんだか現実味がないわ。

key: All things do fade away in time, it seems...
en: All things do fade away in time, it seems...
ja: 何もかも、いつかは消えていくものみたいね……

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 30!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 30!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果解説書30を手に入れた!

key: Info on Mirror Arena now available!
en: Info on Mirror Arena now available!
ja: ミラーアリーナの情報が見られるようになった!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
